milestone_description: In the proof of Theorem 6.4 (size and time): since $\mathcal V_r\subseteq\mathcal D_r\times\Sigma^{\mathsf q}$, the number of accepting views satisfies $\mathsf m\le2^{\mathsf R}\cdot\mathsf k\cdot|\Sigma|^{\mathsf q}$, where $\mathsf k=\max_r|\mathcal D_r|$ is the maximum number of predicates per random string. The milestone allows any upper bound $\mathsf k$ on the sizes $|\mathcal D_r|$.

milestone_title: Theorem 6.4, inequality (31) — the average list size
milestone_description: In the soundness proof of Theorem 6.4, soundness of the PCP gives $\mathsf s\ge2^{-\mathsf R}\sum_r\prod_{j=1}^{\mathsf q}|\Lambda_{u_{r,j}}|^{-1}$, and two applications of Jensen's inequality give $\mathsf s\ge\overline\Lambda^{-\mathsf q}$ for the average list size $\overline\Lambda$ (31). The milestone is the passage from the first bound to the last, for arbitrary positive reals $\lambda_{r,j}$ in place of the list sizes: if $(\sum_r\prod_j\lambda_{r,j}^{-1})\cdot t^{q}\le|R|$ for some $t>0$, then $|R|\cdot q\cdot t\le\sum_r\sum_j\lambda_{r,j}$.

For Construction 6.2, if the PCP has perfect completeness, then for every $x\in\mathsf L(\mathcal R)\cap\{0,1\}^{n}$ the target satisfies $\Delta(y_x,C)\le Y$, where $Y=B\cdot2^{\mathsf R}\cdot\mathsf q$. The milestone is stated for an arbitrary language and instance set, and needs no hypothesis on the encoding map or on $\Gamma$.

For Construction 6.2, suppose that the PCP has soundness error $0<\mathsf s<1$, that $\iota$ is injective and the code $\iota(F^{\mathsf m})$ has relative distance $\delta$, and that $\Gamma<\delta\cdot\mathsf s^{-1/\mathsf q}$ (28). Then for every $x\in\{0,1\}^{n}\setminus\mathsf L(\mathcal R)$ the target satisfies $\Delta(y_x,C)>\Gamma\cdot Y$. The milestone assumes only $\mathsf s>0$ and that every nonzero codeword of $\iota(F^{\mathsf m})$ has weight at least $\delta\cdot B$.

milestone_title: Theorem 6.4 — the reduction from query-oblivious PCPs
milestone_description: For Construction 6.2, suppose that the PCP has instance-independent query locations and predicate families enumerable as in Definition 6.1, perfect completeness and soundness error $0<\mathsf s<1$, that $\iota$ is injective and the code $\iota(F^{\mathsf m})$ has relative distance $\delta$, and that $\Gamma<\delta\cdot\mathsf s^{-1/\mathsf q}$. Then $\Delta(y_x,C)\le Y$ for every $x\in\mathsf L(\mathcal R)\cap\{0,1\}^{n}$, $\Delta(y_x,C)>\Gamma\cdot Y$ for every $x\in\{0,1\}^{n}\setminus\mathsf L(\mathcal R)$, and the code has block length $M=(|\Sigma|+\Gamma)\cdot Y+1$ and depends only on the PCP, the encoding map and $\Gamma$. The milestone states these three items; the running-time claims of the theorem are not formalized.
